DERIVED SOFTWARE QUALITY GATE, NOT AN FSG RULE. Every material/process/fastener cost value used by the evaluator must have a non-null source_id that exists as a row in docs/source_register.csv. This is a proxy/internal check supporting S_3.5.11 (realistic costs) but is explicitly separate from it - S_3.5.11 itself remains interpretive/non-deterministic since 'realistic' has no fixed threshold and cannot be proven by this or any other automated check. This gate only verifies traceability (a source exists), not realism/correctness of the cost value itself. Passing this check is necessary but not sufficient for S_3.5.11 compliance.
